aboutPage.heroP: A plant science company committed to sustainable agriculture — importing and distributing crop protection products and seeds for growers across Pakistan.
paras: Arfa Chemicals was incorporated in 2025 as an unlisted public company. The principal activities of the company comprise the import and sale of agricultural products, and we are engaged in the distribution and sale of crop protection products alongside the seeds business.

Through world-class science and innovative crop solutions, our people are working to transform how crops are grown. We are committed to rescuing land from degradation, enhancing biodiversity and revitalizing rural communities — helping to improve food security by enabling farmers to make better use of available resources.

We provide products and solutions that help farmers achieve food security for a growing population, sustainably. We look at agriculture through the eyes of growers, and apply that understanding to every product we import and every recommendation we make.
aboutPage.visionP: Arfa Chemicals is a plant science company committed to promoting sustainable agriculture through innovation, research and technology. Our aim is to help feed a growing population by bringing plant potential to life.
aboutPage.ambitionP: To bring greater food security — in an environmentally sustainable way — to an increasingly populous world, by creating a step change in farm productivity.
aboutPage.supplyP1: Our crop protection range comprises insecticides for control of pests affecting food and cash crops, fungicides against plant diseases and herbicides for weed control, particularly in food crops. With a broad range of safe and efficient products, we improve crop yield and health at every stage of plant development.
aboutPage.supplyP2: Our insecticides and fungicides protect the crop from insects and disease and improve plant vigour. Our herbicides control weeds, which can reduce yields through competition for nutrients, water and light. Modern chemical technologies also help plants reduce yield losses during periods of drought or heat. Whether growers raise corn or rice, vegetables or cash crops, our innovations help them overcome the challenges of the season — from sowing to harvest.
